library.name: Library
library.description: Halfway between an archive and an alchemy lab, this place is crowded with information. How much use it is to anyone is debatable.

north_hall.name: North Hall
north_hall.description: The imposing corridor seems carved out of whole stone. You might believe you were inside a mountain if not for the windows revealing the blackness of the Void.

cafeteria.name: Cafeteria
cafeteria.description: The warmth of ovens and the smell of food makes this a welcoming place. There's always someone here, though they might be too focused on food to speak with you.

secret_passage.name: Secret Passage
secret_passage.description: Hidden behind a stack of crates, you can tell this passage was deliberately hidden. Judging by the carpet of cobwebs and dust in this otherwise very neat place, it has been that way for some time.

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.description: This must be where the facility grows all its food and components. The air is humid, and you're initially tricked into thinking sunlight filters down from the ceiling, but it's just more alchemical lights.

south_hall.name: South Hall
south_hall.description: The corridor is a sharp contrast to the rest of the facility, with plaster walls and wooden framing. A variety of doors to different dormitories line the walls.

rotunda.name: Rotunda
rotunda.description: This is the facility's entrance. Hallways split off in two directions, going deeper in. The heavy portal door to the outside is currently sealed shut with a magic you can't identify.

balcony.name: Balcony
balcony.description: There is nothing to see off the edge of the balcony but the infinite blackness of the Void. The area has been decorated nicely, though, with plants and an abundance of lanterns.
